Headline: Red Line Service Delayed at North/Clybourn
ShortDescription: Red Line trains are standing near North/Clybourn due to unauthorized person on the tracks. Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Red Line trains are standing near North/Clybourn due to unauthorized person on the tracks.

Red Line trains are rerouted to the elevated lines between Fullerton and Clark/Lake. 

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
